summary: Small consistency fix in the knowledge record. The boundary statement about which entry points the disarmed proposal gate covers now exists twice: the original entry recorded it as source-derived and explicitly not executed, and the previous batch created a second entry carrying the same statement with the read-index receipt. The original entry is corrected to cite that executed evidence, with a changed_premise explaining that its conditions no longer claim the boundary is unobserved while the statement itself is unchanged, and the receipt is attached to it so either entry can be cited. No interpretation used the original entry, so no recorded use needs re-evaluation and no affected uses are claimed. The submission carries no experiment and requests no execution. The audit as a whole now stands at one asserted defect with ten receipts and five independent controls, two bounded safety negatives, one recovery scenario, a read-index boundary control, and per-question limitations that state what was witnessed, what is bounded and what was deliberately not sampled.
